definition.title: Complete a commitment
definition.description: Determine whether one complete static plan can satisfy every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted scenario. Compare feasible plans only after whole-plan execution feasibility is established.

authoring.guidance:
What must be completed, for whom, and within which accepted limits?
Which objects, quantities, revisions and locations are covered?
Which factual records and admitted states are we relying on?
Which complete choices may the planner make?
Which activities, dependencies, calendars and capacities must the same plan respect?
Which scoped permissions must cover each required operation?
Which joint operating scenarios must this commitment withstand?
Which obligations are mandatory, and how will passing complete plans be compared?
Module authors supply these declarations and domain vocabulary. Case workers supply only values allowed by the frozen module. Facts, scenarios and operating permission must never be inferred from a preferred plan.

definition.title: Complete a commitment
definition.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.
An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.
Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.
Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.
Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.
Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.
Every mandatory condition must pass for the same choice in every admitted scenario. Preference cannot compensate for failure.
Ranking is lexicographic over feasible choices only; genuine ties are retained and identifiers only stabilize display order.
A fully checked witness establishes existence during partial search. No-plan and optimality claims require complete relevant coverage.
Missing data, unresolved lookups, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported declarations are invalid input, never invented facts.
Calculated feasibility is conditional on accepted facts and fixed assumptions, not permission, reservation or evidence of actual completion.

expressionLanguage.literals: Finite scalar or homogeneous scalar-array data; no executable code.

operators.add: At least two compatible numbers -> number
operators.mul: Two numbers with at most one dimensional operand -> number; count is a multiplicity
operators.lookup: Complete primary-key binding in a typed input table -> exactly one selected scalar; missing or ambiguous lookup is invalid
operators.exists: Typed equality bindings plus optional row-scoped predicate -> boolean; no match is false
operators.interval-covered: Typed selected calendar rows and a positive half-open interval -> boolean; adjacent coverage may combine
operators.worst-case: Numeric expression -> maximum across admitted scenarios for preference only; nested or unreduced scenario aggregates are invalid

caseDerivation: All case parameters and keyed input rows use the frozen module.inputs types, units, bounds, keys and references; no missing-value defaults or coercion are inferred.
Finite choices draw only from input arrays, input table columns or fixed literal domains; the same assignment applies to every scenario.
The scenarioDomain table explicitly lists admitted joint scenarios; an empty table is an inconsistent basis rather than vacuous feasibility.
Activity graphs, constraints, mandatory obligations, resource mappings, financial mode and preference remain frozen module declarations.
Provenance describes accepted factual sources; identifying a source does not authenticate it or infer readiness.
schema.description: Installed closed typed declaration and case-admission validators; this descriptor is not a complete JSON Schema. Publication checks admission, not computed feasibility.

structuralSlots.description: Declare one time origin, common time and money units, and additional numeric units.
Declare required typed parameters and keyed relations.
Declare finite static controls from input-only domains.
Bind the input relation containing explicit joint scenarios.
Bind typed acyclic consequences using the installed expression language.
Declare static activity actors, timing and renewable resource demands.
Map resource capacities and existing bookings.
Name and explain every mandatory commitment obligation.
Bind predicates and shared resource-capacity checks to obligations.
Declare nonrefundable charges and optional timed refundable holds.
Optionally require complete finite lookup coverage.
Supply domain vocabulary without changing calculations.
State accepted premises and the applicability boundary.

caseInputs.description: Supply every declared parameter, including finite choice grids and current limits.
Supply typed records, accepted scenarios, calendars, grants, resources and other declared facts.
Record the accepted source and scope of supplied information.

app.name: Resolve a shipment exception
app.description: Compare supported complete shipment arrangements before their booking cutoffs. Prefer the lowest complete expense; use earlier arrival only to break equal-expense ties. A current quote and exact-scope operating records remain mandatory. Planned follow-up never creates a supporting record.
app.source:
# Canonical Decision Lab data. Rules are data, never executable code.
format: complete-a-commitment/1
module:
  id: shipment-exception-response
  title: Resolve a shipment exception
  description: "Compare supported complete shipment arrangements before their booking cutoffs. Prefer the lowest complete expense; use earlier arrival only to break equal-expense ties. A current quote and exact-scope operating records remain mandatory. Planned follow-up never creates a supporting record."
  preference:
    direction: min
    expression:
      ref: finance.expense
    then:
      - direction: min
        expression:
          ref: derived.arrival
  version: "2.0.0"
  metadata:
    catalog:
      domain:
        id: order-fulfillment
        label: Order fulfillment
        description: "Review delivery commitments, operating prerequisites and shipment arrangements."
      useCase:
        id: review-first-shipment
        label: Review a first shipment
        description: Review one shipment before committing money to an arrangement.
  question: "Which supported arrangement protects this shipment commitment at the lowest complete expense?"
  template:
    id: complete-a-commitment
    version: 1
  units:
    time: minute
    timeOrigin: "Minute 0 is 2026-11-17T00:00:00-06:00; fixed UTC-06:00 for this bounded shipment horizon."
    money: USD cent
    count: unit of resource capacity
    quantity: case
  assumptions: ["This fictional case contains one accepted order revision for 100 cases, complete mutually exclusive arrangements and a fixed receipt commitment. Direct, Backup and Consolidated are the only reviewed arrangement identities; an unfamiliar option must receive an authored policy before it can pass.", The listed operating states are a reviewed projection of the evidence result. No probabilities are inferred from evidence or used to remove a mandatory scenario., Direct transportation requires registered SP-A. The backup uses independently registered SP-B in either state. Portal presence does not establish transportation registration., "Each arrangement includes all packing, release and freight expense in its quoted fee. Preparation and resource use are explicitly checked and add no separate charge.", "The accepted 100 cases are stipulated to be available to either complete arrangement; this profile does not perform inventory allocation, manufacturing or replenishment.", "All tasks use half-open intervals. Packing starts when the arrangement can be selected; final release follows packing and must finish before the fixed offered departure.", "studyFee is one prospective or incurred verification fee counted once. The payment time is studyFeeAt, and the complete quoted arrangement fee is paid when that arrangement can be selected. There are no deposits, refunds, revenue or additional financing.", A complete static arrangement is assessed against every retained state. Learning may later choose among these complete arrangements only through separately checked report branches., A nonzero verification fee needs an independently recorded scoped purchase grant and study-purchase cap at its payment time. Missing authority cannot be replaced by available budget or positive expected benefit., "Both SP-A and SP-B are stipulated transportation-registered for the exact shipment scope. Consolidated uses the already registered SP-B; this example does not establish a new ship point registration.", "slotConfirmations is a complete current-status register, not a history of events. Its arrangement key permits at most one resolved current record per arrangement. The logistics coordinator must reconcile conflicting messages to status conflicting, and replace a cancelled confirmation with status cancelled; duplicate current rows are invalid inputs. The model does not authenticate supplier messages or reconcile an event stream.", "Consolidated needs status confirmed for this arrangement, ship point, order revision, recipient, ship date and profile. Confirmation must exist and be known at selection time, be confirmed by the reservation cutoff, and cover the full half-open 60-minute loading window immediately before carrier departure. Missing, cancelled, conflicting, late or incorrectly scoped confirmation does not establish the requirement. This checks the recorded slot; it does not schedule loading work or resolve physical dock capacity conflicts.", "Direct and Backup retain their original operating policies. The slot condition applies only to the authored Consolidated identity, while the separate reviewed-arrangement policy rejects unknown identities. No case checkbox can disable this prerequisite.", "Company policy is cost first among complete arrangements meeting the delivery promise, then arrival. Earlier arrival alone does not justify premium spending. Quote validity, permissions and the current assessment time are explicit recorded inputs; changes require reassessment.", "A quote is a current supplied record with its own identity, revision, shipment scope, knowledge and validity times, and carrier booking cutoff. Assessment does not authenticate it. Booking is distinct from delivery; revision of the customer promise is distinct from satisfying the original promise."]

          recipient:

  choices:
    - id: arrangement
      domain:
        table: arrangements
        column: id
  scenarioDomain:
    table: scenarios
  lookupCoverage:
    - table: readiness
      keys:
        stateId:
          domain:
            table: scenarios
            column: stateId
        shipPoint:
          domain:
            table: arrangements
            column: shipPoint
  derived:
    - id: shipPoint
      type: string
      expr:
        op: lookup
        table: arrangements
        where:
          id:
            ref: choice.arrangement
        column: shipPoint
    - id: departure
      type: integer
      unit: time
      expr:
        op: lookup
        table: arrangements
        where:
          id:
            ref: choice.arrangement
        column: departure
    - id: travelDuration
      type: integer
      unit: time
      expr:
        op: lookup
        table: arrangements
        where:
          id:
            ref: choice.arrangement
        column: travelDuration
    - id: arrival
      type: integer
      unit: time
      expr:
        op: add
        args:
          - ref: derived.departure
          - ref: derived.travelDuration
    - id: slotStart
      type: integer
      unit: time
      expr:
        op: sub
        args:
          - ref: derived.departure
          - literal: 60
    - id: quoteKnownAt
      type: integer
      unit: time
      expr:
        op: lookup
        table: arrangements
        where:
          id:
            ref: choice.arrangement
        column: quoteKnownAt
    - id: quoteValidFrom
      type: integer
      unit: time
      expr:
        op: lookup
        table: arrangements
        where:
          id:
            ref: choice.arrangement
        column: quoteValidFrom
    - id: quoteValidUntil
      type: integer
      unit: time
      expr:
        op: lookup
        table: arrangements
        where:

        column: quoteValidUntil
    - id: bookingCutoff
      type: integer
      unit: time
      expr:
        op: lookup
        table: arrangements
        where:
          id:
            ref: choice.arrangement
        column: bookingCutoff
    - id: bookingSlack
      type: integer
      unit: time
      expr:

        args:

  activities:

      actor:

      start:

      duration:

            literal: 1
        - resource:

  requirements:
    - id: SUFFICIENCY
      label: Complete accepted order
      meaning: The arrangement carries the accepted quantity using a transportation-registered ship point for this exact shipment scope.
      waivable: false
    - id: RESOURCES
      label: Preparation staff and workspace
      meaning: "Packing and release have the necessary capabilities, calendars and shared capacity for their complete durations."
      waivable: false
    - id: AUTHORITY
      label: "Purchase, arrangement and final release permission"
      meaning: "Recorded authorities cover verification purchase, arrangement selection and final release for the same order revision, recipient, shipment date and profile. A budget ceiling does not create permission."
      waivable: false
    - id: TIME
      label: "Reservation, preparation and receipt"
      meaning: "Select by the reservation cutoff, finish preparation before departure and meet the receipt deadline."
      waivable: false
    - id: ACCESS
      label: Receiving window
      meaning: Arrival falls within the declared half-open receiving window.
      waivable: false
    - id: COST
      label: Total expense and cash
      meaning: The quoted arrangement fee plus the single prospective or incurred verification fee stay within expense and peak-cash limits.
      waivable: false
    - id: SLOT
      label: Confirmed consolidation slot
      meaning: "Consolidated freight needs a resolved current supplier slot confirmation for this exact shipment, known at selection and covering the full 60-minute loading window immediately before departure."
      waivable: false
    - id: QUOTE
      label: Current scoped carrier offer
      meaning: "The supplied quote covers the current order revision, is already known, remains valid at selection, and can still be booked by its carrier cutoff."

          orderRevision:

          recipient:

          shipDate:

          profileVersion:

      kind: predicate

        table: capabilities
        where:

            ref: activity.pack.actor
          action:
            literal: pack
    - id: pack-availability
      requirement: RESOURCES
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: interval-covered
        table: calendars
        where:
          actor:
            ref: activity.pack.actor

          ref: activity.pack.start
        end:
          ref: activity.pack.end
        startColumn: start
        endColumn: end
    - id: release-capability
      requirement: RESOURCES
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: exists
        table: capabilities
        where:
          actor:
            ref: activity.release.actor
          action:
            literal: release
    - id: release-availability
      requirement: RESOURCES
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: interval-covered
        table: calendars
        where:
          actor:
            ref: activity.release.actor
        start:
          ref: activity.release.start
        end:
          ref: activity.release.end
        startColumn: start
        endColumn: end
    - id: combined-resource-capacity
      requirement: RESOURCES
      kind: resource-capacity
    - id: arrangement-selection-authority
      requirement: AUTHORITY
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: exists
        table: arrangementAuthorities
        where:
          arrangement:
            ref: choice.arrangement
          orderId:
            ref: parameter.orderId
          orderRevision:
            ref: parameter.orderRevision
          recipient:
            ref: parameter.recipient
          shipDate:
            ref: parameter.shipDate
          profileVersion:
            ref: parameter.profileVersion
          shipPoint:
            ref: derived.shipPoint
        test:
          op: and
          args:
            - op: lte
              args:
                - ref: row.start
                - ref: parameter.actionReady
            - op: gt
              args:
                - ref: row.end
                - ref: parameter.actionReady
    - id: scoped-final-release-grant
      requirement: AUTHORITY
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: exists
        table: grants
        where:
          actor:
            ref: parameter.releaseActor
          action:
            literal: release
          arrangement:
            ref: choice.arrangement
          shipPoint:
            ref: derived.shipPoint
          orderId:
            ref: parameter.orderId
          orderRevision:
            ref: parameter.orderRevision
          recipient:
            ref: parameter.recipient
          shipDate:
            ref: parameter.shipDate
          profileVersion:
            ref: parameter.profileVersion
        test:
          op: and
          args:
            - op: lte
              args:
                - ref: row.start
                - ref: activity.release.start
            - op: gte
              args:
                - ref: row.end
                - ref: activity.release.end
    - id: selection-not-in-the-past
      requirement: TIME
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: gte
        args:
          - ref: parameter.actionReady
          - ref: parameter.currentTime
    - id: verification-fee-before-response
      requirement: TIME
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: lte
        args:
          - ref: parameter.studyFeeAt
          - ref: parameter.actionReady
    - id: reserve-before-cutoff
      requirement: TIME
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: lte
        args:
          - ref: parameter.actionReady
          - ref: parameter.reservationDeadline
    - id: preparation-before-departure
      requirement: TIME
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: lte
        args:
          - ref: activity.release.end
          - ref: derived.departure
    - id: receipt-by-required-time
      requirement: TIME
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: lte
        args:
          - ref: derived.arrival
          - ref: parameter.receiptDeadline
    - id: receipt-within-access-window
      requirement: ACCESS
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: and
        args:
          - op: lte
            args:
              - ref: parameter.receiptOpen
              - ref: derived.arrival
          - op: lt
            args:
              - ref: derived.arrival
              - ref: parameter.receiptClose
    - id: total-expense-limit
      requirement: COST
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: lte
        args:
          - ref: finance.expense
          - ref: parameter.expenseLimit
    - id: peak-cash-limit
      requirement: COST
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: lte
        args:
          - ref: finance.peakCash
          - ref: parameter.cashLimit
    - id: scoped-verification-purchase-grant
      requirement: AUTHORITY
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: or
        args:
          - op: eq
            args:
              - ref: parameter.studyFee
              - literal: 0
          - op: and
            args:
              - op: lte
                args:
                  - ref: parameter.studyFee
                  - ref: parameter.studyPurchaseCap
              - op: exists
                table: studyPurchaseGrants
                where:
                  actor:
                    ref: parameter.studyPurchaser
                  orderId:
                    ref: parameter.orderId
                  orderRevision:
                    ref: parameter.orderRevision
                  recipient:
                    ref: parameter.recipient
                  shipDate:
                    ref: parameter.shipDate
                  profileVersion:
                    ref: parameter.profileVersion
                  action:
                    literal: purchase-verification
                test:
                  op: and
                  args:
                    - op: lte
                      args:

definitionContract.title: Complete a commitment
definitionContract.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.
An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.
Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.
Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.
Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.
Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.
Every mandatory condition must pass for the same choice in every admitted scenario. Preference cannot compensate for failure.
Ranking is lexicographic over feasible choices only; genuine ties are retained and identifiers only stabilize display order.
A fully checked witness establishes existence during partial search. No-plan and optimality claims require complete relevant coverage.
Missing data, unresolved lookups, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported declarations are invalid input, never invented facts.
Calculated feasibility is conditional on accepted facts and fixed assumptions, not permission, reservation or evidence of actual completion.

expressionLanguage.literals: Finite scalar or homogeneous scalar-array data; no executable code.

operators.add: At least two compatible numbers -> number
operators.mul: Two numbers with at most one dimensional operand -> number; count is a multiplicity
operators.lookup: Complete primary-key binding in a typed input table -> exactly one selected scalar; missing or ambiguous lookup is invalid
operators.exists: Typed equality bindings plus optional row-scoped predicate -> boolean; no match is false
operators.interval-covered: Typed selected calendar rows and a positive half-open interval -> boolean; adjacent coverage may combine
operators.worst-case: Numeric expression -> maximum across admitted scenarios for preference only; nested or unreduced scenario aggregates are invalid

module.title: Resolve a shipment exception
module.description: Compare supported complete shipment arrangements before their booking cutoffs. Prefer the lowest complete expense; use earlier arrival only to break equal-expense ties. A current quote and exact-scope operating records remain mandatory. Planned follow-up never creates a supporting record.

domain.label: Order fulfillment
domain.description: Review delivery commitments, operating prerequisites and shipment arrangements.

useCase.label: Review a first shipment
useCase.description: Review one shipment before committing money to an arrangement.

module.question: Which supported arrangement protects this shipment commitment at the lowest complete expense?

units.timeOrigin: Minute 0 is 2026-11-17T00:00:00-06:00; fixed UTC-06:00 for this bounded shipment horizon.

assumptions: This fictional case contains one accepted order revision for 100 cases, complete mutually exclusive arrangements and a fixed receipt commitment. Direct, Backup and Consolidated are the only reviewed arrangement identities; an unfamiliar option must receive an authored policy before it can pass.
The listed operating states are a reviewed projection of the evidence result. No probabilities are inferred from evidence or used to remove a mandatory scenario.
Direct transportation requires registered SP-A. The backup uses independently registered SP-B in either state. Portal presence does not establish transportation registration.
Each arrangement includes all packing, release and freight expense in its quoted fee. Preparation and resource use are explicitly checked and add no separate charge.
The accepted 100 cases are stipulated to be available to either complete arrangement; this profile does not perform inventory allocation, manufacturing or replenishment.
All tasks use half-open intervals. Packing starts when the arrangement can be selected; final release follows packing and must finish before the fixed offered departure.

studyFee is one prospective or incurred verification fee counted once. The payment time is studyFeeAt, and the complete quoted arrangement fee is paid when that arrangement can be selected. There are no deposits, refunds, revenue or additional financing.
A complete static arrangement is assessed against every retained state. Learning may later choose among these complete arrangements only through separately checked report branches.

A nonzero verification fee needs an independently recorded scoped purchase grant and study-purchase cap at its payment time. Missing authority cannot be replaced by available budget or positive expected benefit.
Both SP-A and SP-B are stipulated transportation-registered for the exact shipment scope. Consolidated uses the already registered SP-B; this example does not establish a new ship point registration.

slotConfirmations is a complete current-status register, not a history of events. Its arrangement key permits at most one resolved current record per arrangement. The logistics coordinator must reconcile conflicting messages to status conflicting, and replace a cancelled confirmation with status cancelled; duplicate current rows are invalid inputs. The model does not authenticate supplier messages or reconcile an event stream.

Consolidated needs status confirmed for this arrangement, ship point, order revision, recipient, ship date and profile. Confirmation must exist and be known at selection time, be confirmed by the reservation cutoff, and cover the full half-open 60-minute loading window immediately before carrier departure. Missing, cancelled, conflicting, late or incorrectly scoped confirmation does not establish the requirement. This checks the recorded slot; it does not schedule loading work or resolve physical dock capacity conflicts.

Direct and Backup retain their original operating policies. The slot condition applies only to the authored Consolidated identity, while the separate reviewed-arrangement policy rejects unknown identities. No case checkbox can disable this prerequisite.

Company policy is cost first among complete arrangements meeting the delivery promise, then arrival. Earlier arrival alone does not justify premium spending. Quote validity, permissions and the current assessment time are explicit recorded inputs; changes require reassessment.

A quote is a current supplied record with its own identity, revision, shipment scope, knowledge and validity times, and carrier booking cutoff. Assessment does not authenticate it. Booking is distinct from delivery; revision of the customer promise is distinct from satisfying the original promise.

requirements.label: Preparation staff and workspace
requirements.meaning: Packing and release have the necessary capabilities, calendars and shared capacity for their complete durations.

requirements.label: Purchase, arrangement and final release permission
requirements.meaning: Recorded authorities cover verification purchase, arrangement selection and final release for the same order revision, recipient, shipment date and profile. A budget ceiling does not create permission.

requirements.label: Reservation, preparation and receipt
requirements.meaning: Select by the reservation cutoff, finish preparation before departure and meet the receipt deadline.

requirements.label: Receiving window
requirements.meaning: Arrival falls within the declared half-open receiving window.

requirements.label: Total expense and cash
requirements.meaning: The quoted arrangement fee plus the single prospective or incurred verification fee stay within expense and peak-cash limits.

requirements.label: Confirmed consolidation slot
requirements.meaning: Consolidated freight needs a resolved current supplier slot confirmation for this exact shipment, known at selection and covering the full 60-minute loading window immediately before departure.

requirements.label: Current scoped carrier offer
requirements.meaning: The supplied quote covers the current order revision, is already known, remains valid at selection, and can still be booked by its carrier cutoff.

provenance.description: Fictional retained case for independent shipment SHIP-105. Preparation actors are shipment-specific. The model-local packing-bench resource is separately allocated to this case; the batch does not claim joint resource feasibility. This file records the supplied readiness, authority registry, calendars and resources; no live supplier records are represented.

Fictional retained case for independent shipment SHIP-105. Preparation actors are shipment-specific. The model-local packing-bench resource is separately allocated to this case; the batch does not claim joint resource feasibility. This file records the supplied readiness, authority registry, calendars and resources; no live supplier records are represented.

assumptions: This fictional case contains one accepted order revision for 100 cases, complete mutually exclusive arrangements and a fixed receipt commitment. Direct, Backup and Consolidated are the only reviewed arrangement identities; an unfamiliar option must receive an authored policy before it can pass.
The listed operating states are a reviewed projection of the evidence result. No probabilities are inferred from evidence or used to remove a mandatory scenario.
Direct transportation requires registered SP-A. The backup uses independently registered SP-B in either state. Portal presence does not establish transportation registration.
Each arrangement includes all packing, release and freight expense in its quoted fee. Preparation and resource use are explicitly checked and add no separate charge.
The accepted 100 cases are stipulated to be available to either complete arrangement; this profile does not perform inventory allocation, manufacturing or replenishment.
All tasks use half-open intervals. Packing starts when the arrangement can be selected; final release follows packing and must finish before the fixed offered departure.

studyFee is one prospective or incurred verification fee counted once. The payment time is studyFeeAt, and the complete quoted arrangement fee is paid when that arrangement can be selected. There are no deposits, refunds, revenue or additional financing.
A complete static arrangement is assessed against every retained state. Learning may later choose among these complete arrangements only through separately checked report branches.

A nonzero verification fee needs an independently recorded scoped purchase grant and study-purchase cap at its payment time. Missing authority cannot be replaced by available budget or positive expected benefit.
Both SP-A and SP-B are stipulated transportation-registered for the exact shipment scope. Consolidated uses the already registered SP-B; this example does not establish a new ship point registration.

slotConfirmations is a complete current-status register, not a history of events. Its arrangement key permits at most one resolved current record per arrangement. The logistics coordinator must reconcile conflicting messages to status conflicting, and replace a cancelled confirmation with status cancelled; duplicate current rows are invalid inputs. The model does not authenticate supplier messages or reconcile an event stream.

Consolidated needs status confirmed for this arrangement, ship point, order revision, recipient, ship date and profile. Confirmation must exist and be known at selection time, be confirmed by the reservation cutoff, and cover the full half-open 60-minute loading window immediately before carrier departure. Missing, cancelled, conflicting, late or incorrectly scoped confirmation does not establish the requirement. This checks the recorded slot; it does not schedule loading work or resolve physical dock capacity conflicts.

Direct and Backup retain their original operating policies. The slot condition applies only to the authored Consolidated identity, while the separate reviewed-arrangement policy rejects unknown identities. No case checkbox can disable this prerequisite.

Company policy is cost first among complete arrangements meeting the delivery promise, then arrival. Earlier arrival alone does not justify premium spending. Quote validity, permissions and the current assessment time are explicit recorded inputs; changes require reassessment.

A quote is a current supplied record with its own identity, revision, shipment scope, knowledge and validity times, and carrier booking cutoff. Assessment does not authenticate it. Booking is distinct from delivery; revision of the customer promise is distinct from satisfying the original promise.

requirements.label: Current scoped carrier offer
requirements.meaning: The supplied quote covers the current order revision, is already known, remains valid at selection, and can still be booked by its carrier cutoff.

nodes: This fictional case contains one accepted order revision for 100 cases, complete mutually exclusive arrangements and a fixed receipt commitment. Direct, Backup and Consolidated are the only reviewed arrangement identities; an unfamiliar option must receive an authored policy before it can pass.
The listed operating states are a reviewed projection of the evidence result. No probabilities are inferred from evidence or used to remove a mandatory scenario.
Direct transportation requires registered SP-A. The backup uses independently registered SP-B in either state. Portal presence does not establish transportation registration.
Each arrangement includes all packing, release and freight expense in its quoted fee. Preparation and resource use are explicitly checked and add no separate charge.
The accepted 100 cases are stipulated to be available to either complete arrangement; this profile does not perform inventory allocation, manufacturing or replenishment.
All tasks use half-open intervals. Packing starts when the arrangement can be selected; final release follows packing and must finish before the fixed offered departure.

studyFee is one prospective or incurred verification fee counted once. The payment time is studyFeeAt, and the complete quoted arrangement fee is paid when that arrangement can be selected. There are no deposits, refunds, revenue or additional financing.
A complete static arrangement is assessed against every retained state. Learning may later choose among these complete arrangements only through separately checked report branches.

A nonzero verification fee needs an independently recorded scoped purchase grant and study-purchase cap at its payment time. Missing authority cannot be replaced by available budget or positive expected benefit.
Both SP-A and SP-B are stipulated transportation-registered for the exact shipment scope. Consolidated uses the already registered SP-B; this example does not establish a new ship point registration.

slotConfirmations is a complete current-status register, not a history of events. Its arrangement key permits at most one resolved current record per arrangement. The logistics coordinator must reconcile conflicting messages to status conflicting, and replace a cancelled confirmation with status cancelled; duplicate current rows are invalid inputs. The model does not authenticate supplier messages or reconcile an event stream.

Consolidated needs status confirmed for this arrangement, ship point, order revision, recipient, ship date and profile. Confirmation must exist and be known at selection time, be confirmed by the reservation cutoff, and cover the full half-open 60-minute loading window immediately before carrier departure. Missing, cancelled, conflicting, late or incorrectly scoped confirmation does not establish the requirement. This checks the recorded slot; it does not schedule loading work or resolve physical dock capacity conflicts.

Direct and Backup retain their original operating policies. The slot condition applies only to the authored Consolidated identity, while the separate reviewed-arrangement policy rejects unknown identities. No case checkbox can disable this prerequisite.

Company policy is cost first among complete arrangements meeting the delivery promise, then arrival. Earlier arrival alone does not justify premium spending. Quote validity, permissions and the current assessment time are explicit recorded inputs; changes require reassessment.

A quote is a current supplied record with its own identity, revision, shipment scope, knowledge and validity times, and carrier booking cutoff. Assessment does not authenticate it. Booking is distinct from delivery; revision of the customer promise is distinct from satisfying the original promise.

The model-local packing-bench resource is separately allocated to this case; the batch does not claim joint resource feasibility. This file records the supplied readiness, authority registry, calendars and resources; no live supplier records are represented.

The model-local packing-bench resource is separately allocated to this case; the batch does not claim joint resource feasibility. This file records the supplied readiness, authority registry, calendars and resources; no live supplier records are represented.

assumptions: This fictional case contains one accepted order revision for 100 cases, complete mutually exclusive arrangements and a fixed receipt commitment. Direct, Backup and Consolidated are the only reviewed arrangement identities; an unfamiliar option must receive an authored policy before it can pass.
The listed operating states are a reviewed projection of the evidence result. No probabilities are inferred from evidence or used to remove a mandatory scenario.
Direct transportation requires registered SP-A. The backup uses independently registered SP-B in either state. Portal presence does not establish transportation registration.
Each arrangement includes all packing, release and freight expense in its quoted fee. Preparation and resource use are explicitly checked and add no separate charge.
The accepted 100 cases are stipulated to be available to either complete arrangement; this profile does not perform inventory allocation, manufacturing or replenishment.
All tasks use half-open intervals. Packing starts when the arrangement can be selected; final release follows packing and must finish before the fixed offered departure.

studyFee is one prospective or incurred verification fee counted once. The payment time is studyFeeAt, and the complete quoted arrangement fee is paid when that arrangement can be selected. There are no deposits, refunds, revenue or additional financing.
A complete static arrangement is assessed against every retained state. Learning may later choose among these complete arrangements only through separately checked report branches.

A nonzero verification fee needs an independently recorded scoped purchase grant and study-purchase cap at its payment time. Missing authority cannot be replaced by available budget or positive expected benefit.
Both SP-A and SP-B are stipulated transportation-registered for the exact shipment scope. Consolidated uses the already registered SP-B; this example does not establish a new ship point registration.

slotConfirmations is a complete current-status register, not a history of events. Its arrangement key permits at most one resolved current record per arrangement. The logistics coordinator must reconcile conflicting messages to status conflicting, and replace a cancelled confirmation with status cancelled; duplicate current rows are invalid inputs. The model does not authenticate supplier messages or reconcile an event stream.

Consolidated needs status confirmed for this arrangement, ship point, order revision, recipient, ship date and profile. Confirmation must exist and be known at selection time, be confirmed by the reservation cutoff, and cover the full half-open 60-minute loading window immediately before carrier departure. Missing, cancelled, conflicting, late or incorrectly scoped confirmation does not establish the requirement. This checks the recorded slot; it does not schedule loading work or resolve physical dock capacity conflicts.

Direct and Backup retain their original operating policies. The slot condition applies only to the authored Consolidated identity, while the separate reviewed-arrangement policy rejects unknown identities. No case checkbox can disable this prerequisite.

Company policy is cost first among complete arrangements meeting the delivery promise, then arrival. Earlier arrival alone does not justify premium spending. Quote validity, permissions and the current assessment time are explicit recorded inputs; changes require reassessment.

A quote is a current supplied record with its own identity, revision, shipment scope, knowledge and validity times, and carrier booking cutoff. Assessment does not authenticate it. Booking is distinct from delivery; revision of the customer promise is distinct from satisfying the original promise.

slotConfirmations is a complete current-status register, not a history of events. Its arrangement key permits at most one resolved current record per arrangement. Consolidated needs status confirmed for this arrangement, ship point, order revision, recipient, ship date and profile. blocks.text: Compare supported complete shipment arrangements before their booking cutoffs. Prefer the lowest complete expense; use earlier arrival only to break equal-expense ties. A current quote and exact-scope operating records remain mandatory. Planned follow-up never creates a supporting record.

This fictional case contains one accepted order revision for 100 cases, complete mutually exclusive arrangements and a fixed receipt commitment. Direct, Backup and Consolidated are the only reviewed arrangement identities; an unfamiliar option must receive an authored policy before it can pass.
The listed operating states are a reviewed projection of the evidence result. No probabilities are inferred from evidence or used to remove a mandatory scenario.
Direct transportation requires registered SP-A. The backup uses independently registered SP-B in either state. Portal presence does not establish transportation registration.
Each arrangement includes all packing, release and freight expense in its quoted fee. Preparation and resource use are explicitly checked and add no separate charge.
The accepted 100 cases are stipulated to be available to either complete arrangement; this profile does not perform inventory allocation, manufacturing or replenishment.
All tasks use half-open intervals. Packing starts when the arrangement can be selected; final release follows packing and must finish before the fixed offered departure.

studyFee is one prospective or incurred verification fee counted once. The payment time is studyFeeAt, and the complete quoted arrangement fee is paid when that arrangement can be selected. There are no deposits, refunds, revenue or additional financing.
A complete static arrangement is assessed against every retained state. Learning may later choose among these complete arrangements only through separately checked report branches.

A nonzero verification fee needs an independently recorded scoped purchase grant and study-purchase cap at its payment time. Missing authority cannot be replaced by available budget or positive expected benefit.
Both SP-A and SP-B are stipulated transportation-registered for the exact shipment scope. Consolidated uses the already registered SP-B; this example does not establish a new ship point registration.

slotConfirmations is a complete current-status register, not a history of events. Its arrangement key permits at most one resolved current record per arrangement. The logistics coordinator must reconcile conflicting messages to status conflicting, and replace a cancelled confirmation with status cancelled; duplicate current rows are invalid inputs. The model does not authenticate supplier messages or reconcile an event stream.

Consolidated needs status confirmed for this arrangement, ship point, order revision, recipient, ship date and profile. Confirmation must exist and be known at selection time, be confirmed by the reservation cutoff, and cover the full half-open 60-minute loading window immediately before carrier departure. Missing, cancelled, conflicting, late or incorrectly scoped confirmation does not establish the requirement. This checks the recorded slot; it does not schedule loading work or resolve physical dock capacity conflicts.

Direct and Backup retain their original operating policies. The slot condition applies only to the authored Consolidated identity, while the separate reviewed-arrangement policy rejects unknown identities. No case checkbox can disable this prerequisite.

Company policy is cost first among complete arrangements meeting the delivery promise, then arrival. Earlier arrival alone does not justify premium spending. Quote validity, permissions and the current assessment time are explicit recorded inputs; changes require reassessment.

A quote is a current supplied record with its own identity, revision, shipment scope, knowledge and validity times, and carrier booking cutoff. Assessment does not authenticate it. Booking is distinct from delivery; revision of the customer promise is distinct from satisfying the original promise.

Fictional retained case for independent shipment SHIP-105. Preparation actors are shipment-specific. The model-local packing-bench resource is separately allocated to this case; the batch does not claim joint resource feasibility. This file records the supplied readiness, authority registry, calendars and resources; no live supplier records are represented.

assumptions: This fictional case contains one accepted order revision for 100 cases, complete mutually exclusive arrangements and a fixed receipt commitment. Direct, Backup and Consolidated are the only reviewed arrangement identities; an unfamiliar option must receive an authored policy before it can pass.
The listed operating states are a reviewed projection of the evidence result. No probabilities are inferred from evidence or used to remove a mandatory scenario.
Direct transportation requires registered SP-A. The backup uses independently registered SP-B in either state. Portal presence does not establish transportation registration.
Each arrangement includes all packing, release and freight expense in its quoted fee. Preparation and resource use are explicitly checked and add no separate charge.
The accepted 100 cases are stipulated to be available to either complete arrangement; this profile does not perform inventory allocation, manufacturing or replenishment.
All tasks use half-open intervals. Packing starts when the arrangement can be selected; final release follows packing and must finish before the fixed offered departure.

studyFee is one prospective or incurred verification fee counted once. The payment time is studyFeeAt, and the complete quoted arrangement fee is paid when that arrangement can be selected. There are no deposits, refunds, revenue or additional financing.
A complete static arrangement is assessed against every retained state. Learning may later choose among these complete arrangements only through separately checked report branches.

A nonzero verification fee needs an independently recorded scoped purchase grant and study-purchase cap at its payment time. Missing authority cannot be replaced by available budget or positive expected benefit.
Both SP-A and SP-B are stipulated transportation-registered for the exact shipment scope. Consolidated uses the already registered SP-B; this example does not establish a new ship point registration.

slotConfirmations is a complete current-status register, not a history of events. Its arrangement key permits at most one resolved current record per arrangement. The logistics coordinator must reconcile conflicting messages to status conflicting, and replace a cancelled confirmation with status cancelled; duplicate current rows are invalid inputs. The model does not authenticate supplier messages or reconcile an event stream.

Consolidated needs status confirmed for this arrangement, ship point, order revision, recipient, ship date and profile. Confirmation must exist and be known at selection time, be confirmed by the reservation cutoff, and cover the full half-open 60-minute loading window immediately before carrier departure. Missing, cancelled, conflicting, late or incorrectly scoped confirmation does not establish the requirement. This checks the recorded slot; it does not schedule loading work or resolve physical dock capacity conflicts.

Direct and Backup retain their original operating policies. The slot condition applies only to the authored Consolidated identity, while the separate reviewed-arrangement policy rejects unknown identities. No case checkbox can disable this prerequisite.

Company policy is cost first among complete arrangements meeting the delivery promise, then arrival. Earlier arrival alone does not justify premium spending. Quote validity, permissions and the current assessment time are explicit recorded inputs; changes require reassessment.

A quote is a current supplied record with its own identity, revision, shipment scope, knowledge and validity times, and carrier booking cutoff. Assessment does not authenticate it. Booking is distinct from delivery; revision of the customer promise is distinct from satisfying the original promise.

nodes: This fictional case contains one accepted order revision for 100 cases, complete mutually exclusive arrangements and a fixed receipt commitment. Direct, Backup and Consolidated are the only reviewed arrangement identities; an unfamiliar option must receive an authored policy before it can pass.
The listed operating states are a reviewed projection of the evidence result. No probabilities are inferred from evidence or used to remove a mandatory scenario.
Direct transportation requires registered SP-A. The backup uses independently registered SP-B in either state. Portal presence does not establish transportation registration.
Each arrangement includes all packing, release and freight expense in its quoted fee. Preparation and resource use are explicitly checked and add no separate charge.
The accepted 100 cases are stipulated to be available to either complete arrangement; this profile does not perform inventory allocation, manufacturing or replenishment.
All tasks use half-open intervals. Packing starts when the arrangement can be selected; final release follows packing and must finish before the fixed offered departure.

studyFee is one prospective or incurred verification fee counted once. The payment time is studyFeeAt, and the complete quoted arrangement fee is paid when that arrangement can be selected. There are no deposits, refunds, revenue or additional financing.
A complete static arrangement is assessed against every retained state. Learning may later choose among these complete arrangements only through separately checked report branches.

A nonzero verification fee needs an independently recorded scoped purchase grant and study-purchase cap at its payment time. Missing authority cannot be replaced by available budget or positive expected benefit.
Both SP-A and SP-B are stipulated transportation-registered for the exact shipment scope. Consolidated uses the already registered SP-B; this example does not establish a new ship point registration.

slotConfirmations is a complete current-status register, not a history of events. Its arrangement key permits at most one resolved current record per arrangement. The logistics coordinator must reconcile conflicting messages to status conflicting, and replace a cancelled confirmation with status cancelled; duplicate current rows are invalid inputs. blocks.text: Compare supported complete shipment arrangements before their booking cutoffs. Prefer the lowest complete expense; use earlier arrival only to break equal-expense ties. A current quote and exact-scope operating records remain mandatory. Planned follow-up never creates a supporting record.

This fictional case contains one accepted order revision for 100 cases, complete mutually exclusive arrangements and a fixed receipt commitment. Direct, Backup and Consolidated are the only reviewed arrangement identities; an unfamiliar option must receive an authored policy before it can pass.
The listed operating states are a reviewed projection of the evidence result. No probabilities are inferred from evidence or used to remove a mandatory scenario.
Direct transportation requires registered SP-A. The backup uses independently registered SP-B in either state. Portal presence does not establish transportation registration.
Each arrangement includes all packing, release and freight expense in its quoted fee. Preparation and resource use are explicitly checked and add no separate charge.
The accepted 100 cases are stipulated to be available to either complete arrangement; this profile does not perform inventory allocation, manufacturing or replenishment.
All tasks use half-open intervals. Packing starts when the arrangement can be selected; final release follows packing and must finish before the fixed offered departure.

studyFee is one prospective or incurred verification fee counted once. The payment time is studyFeeAt, and the complete quoted arrangement fee is paid when that arrangement can be selected. There are no deposits, refunds, revenue or additional financing.
A complete static arrangement is assessed against every retained state. Learning may later choose among these complete arrangements only through separately checked report branches.

A nonzero verification fee needs an independently recorded scoped purchase grant and study-purchase cap at its payment time. Missing authority cannot be replaced by available budget or positive expected benefit.
Both SP-A and SP-B are stipulated transportation-registered for the exact shipment scope. Consolidated uses the already registered SP-B; this example does not establish a new ship point registration.

slotConfirmations is a complete current-status register, not a history of events. Its arrangement key permits at most one resolved current record per arrangement. The logistics coordinator must reconcile conflicting messages to status conflicting, and replace a cancelled confirmation with status cancelled; duplicate current rows are invalid inputs. The model does not authenticate supplier messages or reconcile an event stream.

Consolidated needs status confirmed for this arrangement, ship point, order revision, recipient, ship date and profile. Confirmation must exist and be known at selection time, be confirmed by the reservation cutoff, and cover the full half-open 60-minute loading window immediately before carrier departure. Missing, cancelled, conflicting, late or incorrectly scoped confirmation does not establish the requirement. This checks the recorded slot; it does not schedule loading work or resolve physical dock capacity conflicts.

Direct and Backup retain their original operating policies. The slot condition applies only to the authored Consolidated identity, while the separate reviewed-arrangement policy rejects unknown identities. No case checkbox can disable this prerequisite.

Company policy is cost first among complete arrangements meeting the delivery promise, then arrival. Earlier arrival alone does not justify premium spending. Quote validity, permissions and the current assessment time are explicit recorded inputs; changes require reassessment.

A quote is a current supplied record with its own identity, revision, shipment scope, knowledge and validity times, and carrier booking cutoff. Assessment does not authenticate it. Booking is distinct from delivery; revision of the customer promise is distinct from satisfying the original promise.

Fictional retained case for independent shipment SHIP-105. Preparation actors are shipment-specific. The model-local packing-bench resource is separately allocated to this case; the batch does not claim joint resource feasibility. This file records the supplied readiness, authority registry, calendars and resources; no live supplier records are represented.

assumptions: This fictional case contains one accepted order revision for 100 cases, complete mutually exclusive arrangements and a fixed receipt commitment. Direct, Backup and Consolidated are the only reviewed arrangement identities; an unfamiliar option must receive an authored policy before it can pass.
The listed operating states are a reviewed projection of the evidence result. No probabilities are inferred from evidence or used to remove a mandatory scenario.
Direct transportation requires registered SP-A. The backup uses independently registered SP-B in either state. Portal presence does not establish transportation registration.
Each arrangement includes all packing, release and freight expense in its quoted fee. Preparation and resource use are explicitly checked and add no separate charge.
The accepted 100 cases are stipulated to be available to either complete arrangement; this profile does not perform inventory allocation, manufacturing or replenishment.
All tasks use half-open intervals. Packing starts when the arrangement can be selected; final release follows packing and must finish before the fixed offered departure.

studyFee is one prospective or incurred verification fee counted once. The payment time is studyFeeAt, and the complete quoted arrangement fee is paid when that arrangement can be selected. There are no deposits, refunds, revenue or additional financing.
A complete static arrangement is assessed against every retained state. Learning may later choose among these complete arrangements only through separately checked report branches.

A nonzero verification fee needs an independently recorded scoped purchase grant and study-purchase cap at its payment time. Missing authority cannot be replaced by available budget or positive expected benefit.
Both SP-A and SP-B are stipulated transportation-registered for the exact shipment scope. Consolidated uses the already registered SP-B; this example does not establish a new ship point registration.

slotConfirmations is a complete current-status register, not a history of events. Its arrangement key permits at most one resolved current record per arrangement. The logistics coordinator must reconcile conflicting messages to status conflicting, and replace a cancelled confirmation with status cancelled; duplicate current rows are invalid inputs. The model does not authenticate supplier messages or reconcile an event stream.

Consolidated needs status confirmed for this arrangement, ship point, order revision, recipient, ship date and profile. Confirmation must exist and be known at selection time, be confirmed by the reservation cutoff, and cover the full half-open 60-minute loading window immediately before carrier departure. Missing, cancelled, conflicting, late or incorrectly scoped confirmation does not establish the requirement. This checks the recorded slot; it does not schedule loading work or resolve physical dock capacity conflicts.

Direct and Backup retain their original operating policies. The slot condition applies only to the authored Consolidated identity, while the separate reviewed-arrangement policy rejects unknown identities. No case checkbox can disable this prerequisite.

Company policy is cost first among complete arrangements meeting the delivery promise, then arrival. Earlier arrival alone does not justify premium spending. Quote validity, permissions and the current assessment time are explicit recorded inputs; changes require reassessment.

A quote is a current supplied record with its own identity, revision, shipment scope, knowledge and validity times, and carrier booking cutoff. Assessment does not authenticate it. Booking is distinct from delivery; revision of the customer promise is distinct from satisfying the original promise.

nodes: This fictional case contains one accepted order revision for 100 cases, complete mutually exclusive arrangements and a fixed receipt commitment. Direct, Backup and Consolidated are the only reviewed arrangement identities; an unfamiliar option must receive an authored policy before it can pass.
The listed operating states are a reviewed projection of the evidence result. No probabilities are inferred from evidence or used to remove a mandatory scenario.
Direct transportation requires registered SP-A. The backup uses independently registered SP-B in either state. Portal presence does not establish transportation registration.
Each arrangement includes all packing, release and freight expense in its quoted fee. Preparation and resource use are explicitly checked and add no separate charge.
The accepted 100 cases are stipulated to be available to either complete arrangement; this profile does not perform inventory allocation, manufacturing or replenishment.
All tasks use half-open intervals. Packing starts when the arrangement can be selected; final release follows packing and must finish before the fixed offered departure.

studyFee is one prospective or incurred verification fee counted once. The payment time is studyFeeAt, and the complete quoted arrangement fee is paid when that arrangement can be selected. There are no deposits, refunds, revenue or additional financing.
A complete static arrangement is assessed against every retained state. Learning may later choose among these complete arrangements only through separately checked report branches.

A nonzero verification fee needs an independently recorded scoped purchase grant and study-purchase cap at its payment time. Missing authority cannot be replaced by available budget or positive expected benefit.
Both SP-A and SP-B are stipulated transportation-registered for the exact shipment scope. Consolidated uses the already registered SP-B; this example does not establish a new ship point registration.

slotConfirmations is a complete current-status register, not a history of events. Its arrangement key permits at most one resolved current record per arrangement. The logistics coordinator must reconcile conflicting messages to status conflicting, and replace a cancelled confirmation with status cancelled; duplicate current rows are invalid inputs. The model does not authenticate supplier messages or reconcile an event stream.

Consolidated needs status confirmed for this arrangement, ship point, order revision, recipient, ship date and profile. Confirmation must exist and be known at selection time, be confirmed by the reservation cutoff, and cover the full half-open 60-minute loading window immediately before carrier departure. Missing, cancelled, conflicting, late or incorrectly scoped confirmation does not establish the requirement. This checks the recorded slot; it does not schedule loading work or resolve physical dock capacity conflicts.

Direct and Backup retain their original operating policies. The slot condition applies only to the authored Consolidated identity, while the separate reviewed-arrangement policy rejects unknown identities. No case checkbox can disable this prerequisite.

Company policy is cost first among complete arrangements meeting the delivery promise, then arrival. Earlier arrival alone does not justify premium spending. Quote validity, permissions and the current assessment time are explicit recorded inputs; changes require reassessment.

A quote is a current supplied record with its own identity, revision, shipment scope, knowledge and validity times, and carrier booking cutoff. Assessment does not authenticate it. Booking is distinct from delivery; revision of the customer promise is distinct from satisfying the original promise.

Fictional retained case for independent shipment SHIP-105. Preparation actors are shipment-specific. The model-local packing-bench resource is separately allocated to this case; the batch does not claim joint resource feasibility. This file records the supplied readiness, authority registry, calendars and resources; no live supplier records are represented.

assumptions: This fictional case contains one accepted order revision for 100 cases, complete mutually exclusive arrangements and a fixed receipt commitment. Direct, Backup and Consolidated are the only reviewed arrangement identities; an unfamiliar option must receive an authored policy before it can pass.

The accepted 100 cases are stipulated to be available to either complete arrangement; this profile does not perform inventory allocation, manufacturing or replenishment.
All tasks use half-open intervals. Packing starts when the arrangement can be selected; final release follows packing and must finish before the fixed offered departure.

studyFee is one prospective or incurred verification fee counted once. The payment time is studyFeeAt, and the complete quoted arrangement fee is paid when that arrangement can be selected. There are no deposits, refunds, revenue or additional financing.

slotConfirmations is a complete current-status register, not a history of events. Its arrangement key permits at most one resolved current record per arrangement. The logistics coordinator must reconcile conflicting messages to status conflicting, and replace a cancelled confirmation with status cancelled; duplicate current rows are invalid inputs. The model does not authenticate supplier messages or reconcile an event stream.

Consolidated needs status confirmed for this arrangement, ship point, order revision, recipient, ship date and profile. Confirmation must exist and be known at selection time, be confirmed by the reservation cutoff, and cover the full half-open 60-minute loading window immediately before carrier departure. Missing, cancelled, conflicting, late or incorrectly scoped confirmation does not establish the requirement. Direct and Backup retain their original operating policies. The slot condition applies only to the authored Consolidated identity, while the separate reviewed-arrangement policy rejects unknown identities. No case checkbox can disable this prerequisite.

Company policy is cost first among complete arrangements meeting the delivery promise, then arrival. Earlier arrival alone does not justify premium spending. Quote validity, permissions and the current assessment time are explicit recorded inputs; changes require reassessment.

A quote is a current supplied record with its own identity, revision, shipment scope, knowledge and validity times, and carrier booking cutoff. Assessment does not authenticate it. Booking is distinct from delivery; revision of the customer promise is distinct from satisfying the original promise.

nodes: This fictional case contains one accepted order revision for 100 cases, complete mutually exclusive arrangements and a fixed receipt commitment. Direct, Backup and Consolidated are the only reviewed arrangement identities; an unfamiliar option must receive an authored policy before it can pass.
The listed operating states are a reviewed projection of the evidence result. No probabilities are inferred from evidence or used to remove a mandatory scenario.
Direct transportation requires registered SP-A. The backup uses independently registered SP-B in either state. Portal presence does not establish transportation registration.
Each arrangement includes all packing, release and freight expense in its quoted fee. Preparation and resource use are explicitly checked and add no separate charge.
The accepted 100 cases are stipulated to be available to either complete arrangement; this profile does not perform inventory allocation, manufacturing or replenishment.
All tasks use half-open intervals. Packing starts when the arrangement can be selected; final release follows packing and must finish before the fixed offered departure.

studyFee is one prospective or incurred verification fee counted once. The payment time is studyFeeAt, and the complete quoted arrangement fee is paid when that arrangement can be selected. There are no deposits, refunds, revenue or additional financing.
A complete static arrangement is assessed against every retained state. Learning may later choose among these complete arrangements only through separately checked report branches.

A nonzero verification fee needs an independently recorded scoped purchase grant and study-purchase cap at its payment time. Missing authority cannot be replaced by available budget or positive expected benefit.
Both SP-A and SP-B are stipulated transportation-registered for the exact shipment scope. Consolidated uses the already registered SP-B; this example does not establish a new ship point registration.

slotConfirmations is a complete current-status register, not a history of events. Its arrangement key permits at most one resolved current record per arrangement. The logistics coordinator must reconcile conflicting messages to status conflicting, and replace a cancelled confirmation with status cancelled; duplicate current rows are invalid inputs. The model does not authenticate supplier messages or reconcile an event stream.

Consolidated needs status confirmed for this arrangement, ship point, order revision, recipient, ship date and profile. Confirmation must exist and be known at selection time, be confirmed by the reservation cutoff, and cover the full half-open 60-minute loading window immediately before carrier departure. Missing, cancelled, conflicting, late or incorrectly scoped confirmation does not establish the requirement. This checks the recorded slot; it does not schedule loading work or resolve physical dock capacity conflicts.

Direct and Backup retain their original operating policies. The slot condition applies only to the authored Consolidated identity, while the separate reviewed-arrangement policy rejects unknown identities. No case checkbox can disable this prerequisite.

Company policy is cost first among complete arrangements meeting the delivery promise, then arrival. Earlier arrival alone does not justify premium spending. Quote validity, permissions and the current assessment time are explicit recorded inputs; changes require reassessment.

A quote is a current supplied record with its own identity, revision, shipment scope, knowledge and validity times, and carrier booking cutoff. Assessment does not authenticate it. Booking is distinct from delivery; revision of the customer promise is distinct from satisfying the original promise.

blocks.text: Compare supported complete shipment arrangements before their booking cutoffs. Prefer the lowest complete expense; use earlier arrival only to break equal-expense ties. A current quote and exact-scope operating records remain mandatory. Planned follow-up never creates a supporting record.

This fictional case contains one accepted order revision for 100 cases, complete mutually exclusive arrangements and a fixed receipt commitment. Direct, Backup and Consolidated are the only reviewed arrangement identities; an unfamiliar option must receive an authored policy before it can pass.
The listed operating states are a reviewed projection of the evidence result. No probabilities are inferred from evidence or used to remove a mandatory scenario.
Direct transportation requires registered SP-A. The backup uses independently registered SP-B in either state. Portal presence does not establish transportation registration.
Each arrangement includes all packing, release and freight expense in its quoted fee. Preparation and resource use are explicitly checked and add no separate charge.
The accepted 100 cases are stipulated to be available to either complete arrangement; this profile does not perform inventory allocation, manufacturing or replenishment.
All tasks use half-open intervals. Packing starts when the arrangement can be selected; final release follows packing and must finish before the fixed offered departure.

studyFee is one prospective or incurred verification fee counted once. The payment time is studyFeeAt, and the complete quoted arrangement fee is paid when that arrangement can be selected. There are no deposits, refunds, revenue or additional financing.
A complete static arrangement is assessed against every retained state. Learning may later choose among these complete arrangements only through separately checked report branches.

A nonzero verification fee needs an independently recorded scoped purchase grant and study-purchase cap at its payment time. Missing authority cannot be replaced by available budget or positive expected benefit.
Both SP-A and SP-B are stipulated transportation-registered for the exact shipment scope. Consolidated uses the already registered SP-B; this example does not establish a new ship point registration.

slotConfirmations is a complete current-status register, not a history of events. Its arrangement key permits at most one resolved current record per arrangement. The logistics coordinator must reconcile conflicting messages to status conflicting, and replace a cancelled confirmation with status cancelled; duplicate current rows are invalid inputs. The model does not authenticate supplier messages or reconcile an event stream.

Consolidated needs status confirmed for this arrangement, ship point, order revision, recipient, ship date and profile. Confirmation must exist and be known at selection time, be confirmed by the reservation cutoff, and cover the full half-open 60-minute loading window immediately before carrier departure. Missing, cancelled, conflicting, late or incorrectly scoped confirmation does not establish the requirement. This checks the recorded slot; it does not schedule loading work or resolve physical dock capacity conflicts.

Direct and Backup retain their original operating policies. The slot condition applies only to the authored Consolidated identity, while the separate reviewed-arrangement policy rejects unknown identities. No case checkbox can disable this prerequisite.

Company policy is cost first among complete arrangements meeting the delivery promise, then arrival. Earlier arrival alone does not justify premium spending. Quote validity, permissions and the current assessment time are explicit recorded inputs; changes require reassessment.

A quote is a current supplied record with its own identity, revision, shipment scope, knowledge and validity times, and carrier booking cutoff. Assessment does not authenticate it. Booking is distinct from delivery; revision of the customer promise is distinct from satisfying the original promise.
